Target files: headroom/transforms/content_router.py, tests/test_transforms/test_content_router.py. A `tool_result` whose `content` is a list of several `text` blocks gets flattened with `"".join(...)` in `ContentRouter` before the read-protection check and before compression. MCP tools that return more than one `TextContent` and litellm-style clients send this shape. When a block does not end with a newline, the last line of one block and... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4739)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Kompress drops Python keywords from a fenced code block inside a mixed tool result
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(router): keep source code out of the prose (Kompress) fallbacks. Target files: crates/headroom-core/src/transforms/code_compressor.rs, crates/headroom-core/src/transforms/live_zone.rs, headroom/transforms/content_router.py. When the code compressor declined a block of source code, the router passed the block to Kompress. Kompress is a prose model. It drops low-salience words, and in code those words are keywords such as `for`, `in`, `if` and `import`. The result no longer parses. #4214 shows a fenced Python scri... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4787)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(lossless): never grep-fold Go, nginx, klog or access-log timestamps. (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4901)

workarounds.symptom: Repeating persona create on a static manager hides the ownership refusal as an unknown write outcome
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(persona): report remote ownership refusals before writes. Target files: implementations/cli/src/commands/persona-remote.ts, implementations/manager/smoke/cli-on-instance-live.smoke.ts, implementations/manager/smoke/manager-service-ops.smoke.ts. Repeating `persona create --on <manager>` on a static-auth space reported an unknown write outcome even though the manager rejected the request before changing the operator-owned persona. The CLI also hid the ownership explanation and provided no edit route. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/7152)

workarounds.symptom: scene_render_status of a finished job fails while a newer job runs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Let scene_render_status answer for a finished job while a newer job runs (#1927). Target files: scripts/agent-runtime.mjs, tests/agent-runtime.test.js, changes/1927.md. `jobStatus` called `requirePreviewRenderer`, which throws when any job is active, for every terminal record it returned. Asking for a finished job while a newer one ran failed with "The renderer is leased". It now only hands the renderer back when no job is active and always returns the record. (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/1930)
